verses.text: And the producers of sparks [when] striking[2]
Arriving thereby in the center[4] collectively,
Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
And indeed, he is to that a witness.[5]
And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
And that within the breasts is obtained,[6]
Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.[7]

footnotes.1: i.e., the horses of those fighting for Allāh's cause as they race to attack the enemy.
footnotes.2: Their hoofs while galloping over rocky terrain.
footnotes.4: i.e., penetrating into the enemy ranks during a surprise attack.
footnotes.5: Through his speech and his actions.
footnotes.6: i.e., when all secrets are made known.
footnotes.7: Fully acquainted and familiar with everything about each one of them.
